principles: Phase gates should block unsafe transitions, not prevent maintenance of already-created reviewer findings.
Flow facts need hard-coded CLI behavior plus prompt guidance, with tests covering the hard boundary.
Minimize command-surface expansion when touching phaseTools.
drivers: SimCell B-cacf demonstrated a DEV workflow dead-end.
finding_cluster is L2 metadata maintenance rather than L4 gate evidence.
DEV already allows finding_add, finding_dispatch, and dispatch.

options.name: A: add finding_cluster only to DEV phaseTools
pros: Directly fixes SimCell B-cacf failure mode
cons: Still leaves process-fact registry and phaseTools as separate concepts

options.name: B: move finding_cluster to global all-phases tools
pros: Makes cluster maintenance available across every phase
Simpler mental model for a read-mostly metadata tool
cons: Expands availability more than the observed bug requires
Allows clustering in INIT/PLAN where reviewer findings should normally not exist

options.name: C: derive phaseTools automatically from process-fact levels
cons: Larger state-machine change for a small hot bug
Requires a broader policy for every L1/L2/L3 command before safe rollout

chosen: A: add finding_cluster only to DEV phaseTools
rationale: Choose the minimal hard-coded fix: DEV already permits reviewer finding creation and fix dispatch, so it must also permit clustering those same findings. This fixes the user-visible failure while preserving unrelated phase restrictions.

preMortem.scenario: DEV becomes too permissive after the change
preMortem.trigger: A broad wildcard or unrelated command is added while fixing finding_cluster
preMortem.consequence: Agents can run mutation commands such as bug_report in DEV that should remain TEST/REVIEW only
preMortem.mitigation: Add negative assertions that bug_report remains blocked in DEV and custom phaseTools still override defaults.

preMortem.scenario: Future refactor removes finding_cluster from DEV again
preMortem.trigger: Someone edits DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS without remembering the SimCell B-cacf workflow
preMortem.consequence: Users again see the DEV-stage unavailable-command error after reviewer findings exist
preMortem.mitigation: Add flow-stability and process-fact contract assertions for finding_add/finding_dispatch/finding_cluster consistency.

preMortem.scenario: Users mistake clustering for resolving findings
preMortem.trigger: Prompt or docs imply cluster output is reviewer pass evidence
preMortem.consequence: Gate semantics weaken because grouped findings are treated as fixed without resolution evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Keep finding_cluster at L2 and assert it is not L4 gate evidence; do not change finding_resolve/review_pass_set semantics.
